w1.title: Orientation & Team Formation
w1.desc: Get introduced to the lab environment, meet mentors, and form multidisciplinary teams based on project interests.

w2.title: Core Training & Workshops
w2.desc: Intensive deep dives into Unity/Unreal, spatial design patterns, and platform-specific XR SDKs.

w3.title: Project Development
w3.desc: Hands-on building phase. Architect and implement the core mechanics of your XR experience.

w4.title: Testing & Iteration
w4.desc: User testing, performance optimization on target hardware, and refining the user experience.

w5.title: Final Presentations & Demo Day
w5.desc: Showcase your polished XR application to industry partners, peers, and sponsors.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.lastUpdated: This is placeholder text — replace it with your actual policy before launch.
PrivacyPage.dataCollectionBody: We collect the information you provide when registering, such as your name, student ID, and email, along with activity data like project applications and team memberships.
PrivacyPage.dataUseBody: Your data is used to operate the cohort platform: matching you with teams and projects, sending announcements, and managing your account.
PrivacyPage.dataSharingBody: We do not sell your data. Information is only visible to cohort staff and, where relevant, your teammates.
PrivacyPage.userRightsBody: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time by contacting the cohort administrators.
PrivacyPage.contactUsBody: For any privacy-related questions, reach out via the Contact page.
